_comment: Shared expectations for App\Services\Slug\Slugger and ~/lib/slug. Both test suites read this file, so a rule changed on one side and not the other fails immediately. Cases whose input is non-Latin belong in the per-suite tests instead: the frontend deliberately does not ship a transliteration table.

cases.why: German expands umlauts rather than folding them
the same text in a language without the expansion folds
French keeps the fold, which is what French wants
no language behaves like English
region subtags are dropped so de-AT does not produce sz
Turkish dotless and dotted i both land on i
Danish expands the Nordic vowels
Swedish folds them instead
Norwegian aliases nb to the no map
Polish letters with no decomposition still fold
Croatian expands the barred d
ampersand becomes a word, not a gap
and it is the language's word
other symbols that carry meaning survive as words
path punctuation separates words instead of gluing them
underscores are a legal slug character and are preserved
an underscore next to a space does not double up
leading and trailing separators are trimmed
runs of separators collapse
emoji leave nothing behind
so does pure punctuation
an empty string stays empty
an already-clean slug is unchanged, so re-saving is idempotent
digits survive
the eszett expands even without a language
capital eszett too
Icelandic thorn and eth fold
the ligature oe folds

truncation.why: cuts on a word boundary rather than mid-word
truncation.value: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen

truncation.why: a single word longer than the limit is cut anyway
input under the limit is untouched

identifiers.why: identifier slugs drop underscores their validators reject
